description: Estimate US landed cost for a part in the Maglev catalog. Needs its catalog id: find it with search_parts first; parts outside the catalog cannot be priced here. Returns goods value + duty stack for the origin (MFN, Section 301, other programs, each with a source) + merchandise processing fee + freight. An estimate, not customs advice.

origin.description: ISO-2 country it ships from; defaults to the part's origin

unit_usd.description: Unit price to use when the part has no listed price

name: landed_cost
title: Estimate US landed cost
